article.title: DSA, Teamsters, Amazon workers fight to pass the Delivery Protection Act
article.author: Editor
article.content: The Delivery Protection Act would curb Amazon outsourcing hiring delivery drivers through contractors, and increase worker protections for these drivers. The post DSA, Teamsters, Amazon workers fight to pass the Delivery Protection Act appeared first on MR Online .
